Sun Wukong went up to Heaven to fetch the Fire-Repelling Cover from him. He returned the Fire-Repelling Cover quickly after, much to Virūpākṣa's surprise and relief.

page.overview:
Who is Virūpākṣa?

Sun Wukong went up to Heaven to fetch the Fire-Repelling Cover from him. He returned the Fire-Repelling Cover quickly after, much to Virūpākṣa's surprise and relief.
